audit.whatIsWrong: Four errors, three of them already found from the other side in audits/top/zac__irelia.json. (1) Irelia's passive is called 'armor shred' in five places — it does not shred resistances. (2) Defiant Dance is offered as the answer to Zac's burst; it reduces PHYSICAL damage only and Zac's damage is magic. (3) Cell Division blobs are described as dropping 'when he takes damage' — they drop when HIS ABILITIES HIT. (4) Cell Division's revive is never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot text — Irelia P: 'she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.' No resistance reduction. Irelia W: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Zac P: 'Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive.' Zac W Unstable Matter is percent-max-health magic damage.
audit.corrected: Say max-stack Ionian Fervor on-hit damage, not armour shred. Do not offer Defiant Dance against magic damage. Blobs come off his ability hits. Killing Zac splits him into 4 bloblets and he revives unless they are cleared.

audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and 6 were marked Skill while every prose field calls them Irelia's skirmish and dive window, and 2+ items was given to Irelia while whys[6] says Zac reclaims relevance as an engager.
audit.why: Zac is slow and immobile between Slingshots (21s at rank 1, 9s at max), which is exactly the target Irelia's E-mark and reset chain wants. His comeback is teamfight utility, not the 1v1. 55.33% over 450 games.
audit.corrected: Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Skill — matched pairs both layers.

audit.why: Spike placement is right — Zac's only early window at 1-3 off a fog Slingshot, Irelia at 3, 6 and first item.
audit.corrected: Spike text at level 6 rewritten so it no longer implies Vanguard's Edge cancels his mobility.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 text said the R wall means he 'can't sling or bounce out', which reads as an interrupt.
audit.why: The mirror audit raised this exact claim and rated it Medium because Riot's text for Vanguard's Edge describes damage, a Mark, and a wall that damages and slows — no interrupt. Both directions now describe only what the text supports.
audit.corrected: The wall damages and slows anything crossing it; place it on his retreat line so the escape costs him health, rather than claiming it stops the dash.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/zac__irelia.json had already established that Defiant Dance is physical-only against Zac's magic damage, that Irelia's passive is attack speed plus on-hit and not armour shred, and that the Vanguard's Edge 'cancels your Slingshot' claim is unsupported. All three are now stated the same way from this side, and the chart is the inverse of nothing contested — the mirror's stage ownership matches. Cell Division's revive (4 bloblets on fatal damage) was absent from the entire page and is now in the 2+ items row. packet.defects' two suspect names are FALSE POSITIVES: 'Let's Bounce' and 'Stretching Strike' are just the punctuation/singular forms of the real names.
